The photo shows a meal before eating, so the leftover figure is a guess. I estimated each item separately.

| Item | Estimate | kcal | Protein | Carbs | Fat |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Brownie | 1 piece | 250 | 3 g | 35 g | 12 g |
| Lasagna | small portion | 250 | 12 g | 25 g | 11 g |
| Fruit salad | 1 cup | 100 | 1 g | 25 g | 0 g |
| Noodles with meat | about 250 g | 400 | 12 g | 55 g | 14 g |
| Sliced beef | about 100 g | 250 | 28 g | 0 g | 15 g |
| Orange juice | 200 ml | 90 | 1 g | 21 g | 0 g |
| Water | 2 glasses | 0 | 0 g | 0 g | 0 g |

Served total: about 1340 kcal.

I assumed about 20% would be left over, roughly 270 kcal. That leaves about 1070 kcal eaten.

The macros for the full meal add up to about 57 g protein, 161 g carbohydrate and 52 g fat. Scaling by 0.8 gives about 46 g protein, 129 g carbohydrate and 42 g fat eaten.
